svg.text: Hey, I'm Arnabh - a 19-year-old AI automation builder and developer from Lucknow. I'm the founder
of Hubrave, a tech-driven digital agency, and I'm studying BCA (Data Science & AI) at SRMU.
AI automation first: I build workflows and AI agents with n8n, Make and Zapier, wired to LLMs like
OpenAI, Claude and Gemini - voice call assistants, lead-response systems and ops automations for
real businesses. I also build the websites and web apps around them - React / Next.js frontends,
Supabase and Node backends, designed in Figma first. My team Sentinels got selected in Smart India
Build products people actually use and pay for, and grow Hubrave into a company that matters - not
Making music as Visxh, playing with my band Kaaya, gaming, and running BGMI scrim tournaments.
